source.name: Gardener gardening website template
source.rightsEvidence: CC BY 4.0 template license retained locally.

provenance.capture: Full-page desktop and mobile captures from the publisher demo at 1440x1000 and 390x844.
provenance.attribution: Gardener gardening website template, CC BY 4.0.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: Gardener gardening website template, CC BY 4.0. Demo content is reference-only.

heroGeometry.alignment: garden image with the promise and primary quote action
heroGeometry.viewport: promise, supporting line and primary action remain visible in the opening desktop viewport

navigationGeometry.placement: compact top bar over the opening image
navigationGeometry.mobile: wordmark and menu control remain visible; navigation stacks without covering the promise

typography.display: bold sans headings with a direct local-service voice
typography.scale: large opening statement, compact section labels and readable service metadata

palette.contrastIntent: dark green actions on light surfaces with legible body copy

imageTreatment.mode: wide garden photography and approved service imagery
imageTreatment.crop: full-bleed opening; contained project and team images
imageTreatment.focalPoint: gardens and planting detail; source people are never client staff

servicePresentation.pattern: service grid with concise scope and a clear contact close
servicePresentation.interaction: static service grid; navigation and quote action remain usable without motion

ctaPlacement.primary: quote or contact action in the opening and contact close

motion.primitive: native menu, card hover and image reveal
motion.library: static HTML/CSS in the source; no runtime dependency is required
motion.reducedMotion: all services, contact details and imagery remain visible without transitions

mobileRecomposition.strategy: stack the opening, services and contact while keeping the primary action visible
rules: keep the promise and quote action before long service detail
collapse the navigation into a readable menu
stack service cards without horizontal page overflow
preserve image crops inside their containers

prohibitedPatterns: copying source branding, copy, demo people, phone numbers, prices, reviews or project claims
presenting template people or garden photography as client staff, customers or completed work
inventing licenses, guarantees, service windows or coverage
using a generic identical card wall for every chapter

requiredSignatureElements.description: a full-bleed garden photograph carries the opening promise and primary quote action
core services appear as a clear icon-led grid with short factual descriptions
completed work or approved garden imagery appears in a project gallery

acceptanceChecks: the opening promise and primary action are visible at desktop and mobile widths
the service grid follows the opening and is grounded in client services
template people are never presented as client staff or customers
the contact action is real and uses only approved client details
the rendered page has no horizontal overflow at 390px and 320px
